Regulation sets

All official events will use Pokémon Champions until further notice.

  • Regulation Set M-B: 17 June–9 September

Regulation Set M-B

The Regulation Set M-B of Pokémon Champions is the second official ruleset. Mega Evolutions are allowed. Regulation Set M-B is the official format of in-game Ranked Battles from 17 June to 9 September 2026 (originally to 2 September 2026).

Regulation Set M-C

The Regulation Set M-C of Pokémon Champions is the third official ruleset. Mega Evolutions are allowed. Regulation Set M-C is the official format of in-game Ranked Battles from 9 September to 2 December 2026, and will be used in most VGC events on the same dates.
